description:
I'm Mohammad, a Palestinian student interested in AI, robotics, and space exploration. My skills include programming, AI tools, and turning ideas into working prototypes.

PIONEER X is a solo team working on the Martian Map challenge: a simple, clear navigation tool built on real NASA data that any astronaut can understand in seconds.

I'm not recruiting at the moment, but happy to connect and exchange ideas at the Ramallah event, Nov 14–15.
